items.title: Meta and BlackRock Partner on $14 Billion Texas Data Centre Development
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) and BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) have agreed to form a joint venture to develop and own a major data centre campus in El Paso, Texas, in a project with an estimated total development cost of approximately $14 billion. The agreement brings together Meta’s expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure plans with BlackRock’s infrastructure investment capabilities.
